prompt: Here are my facts: Case No. 24-123456-DC, 7th Judicial Circuit Court, Family Division, Genesee County; Referee A. Stone under Judge P. Reyes. Order entered March 15, 2023 states parenting time 'as the parties agree.' Communication provision says 'the parties shall communicate regarding parenting time'; the mail-only narrowing came from opposing counsel J. Marsh's letter dated January 8, 2025, not the order. Daughter is 6. Support order credits 104 overnights. Requested time by text 2024-11-02, 2024-12-14, 2025-01-20; each denied/ignored. Other parent's FOC address PO Box 100, Flint MI 48501; counsel J. Marsh, 200 Main St, Flint MI 48502. Conduct audit: dated log kept, no order violations, current on support, no missed exchanges. Want alternating weekends (Fri 6pm-Sun 6pm) + one weeknight dinner (Wed 5-8pm). Draft my motion for specific parenting time.

assertions.text: The motion leads on MCL 722.27a(8) — specific terms if requested by either party at any time — as the primary statutory hook.
Cites Pickering v Pickering, 268 Mich App 1 (2005) for the proposition that vague terms fail the statute once specificity is requested.
Pleads the Shade / Kaeb modification threshold in the alternative, not only the specific-terms hook.
Keeps the ask sized below the ECE-alteration line and/or warns that an over-ask gets recharacterized as a custody motion under Vodvarka.
Adds MCL 722.27a(9) order terms: a defined written communication channel, exchange logistics, and a make-up-time protocol.
The drafted motion is saved as a real file in the run's outputs/ (the user's filing-workspace), not written into the plugin's bundled draft/ directory.
No document is labeled filing-ready; the draft carries its assumed posture / 'do not use if' note.
The child's name and birthdate appear nowhere (age-only is correct); no invented name/DOB.
Every case cited as authority is real and grounded in the skill's ledger/archive; no fabricated or holding-unread citation is relied on in the filing text.
